description: Combat alerts, caster and melee warnings, and general notices. Updated October 2, 2026.

triggers.name: Ammo
triggers.pattern: You have run out of ammo!

triggers.name: Feared
triggers.worn_off_pattern: (?:^You are no longer afraid\.$)|(?:^You have been slain by (?:[^!]+)\!$)

triggers.name: Gate Collapsed
triggers.pattern: ^Your gate is too unstable, and collapses\.$

triggers.name: Gating Mob
triggers.pattern: ^([\w -'`]+) begins to cast the gate spell\.$
triggers.worn_off_pattern: (?:^(You have slain [\w -'`]+|[\w -'`]+ has been slain by (?:[^!]+))\!$)|(?:^[\w -'`]+'s casting is interrupted\!$)

triggers.name: Illusion Fading
triggers.pattern: ^You feel as if you are about to look like yourself again\.$

triggers.name: Levitate Fading
triggers.pattern: ^You feel as if you are about to fall\.$

triggers.name: Rooted Off
triggers.pattern: ^(The roots fall from your feet|Your feet come free)\.$

triggers.name: Summoned
triggers.pattern: ^You have been summone(d|d by a GM)\!$

triggers.name: Trivial
triggers.pattern: ^You can no longer advance your skill

actions.text: Your charm spell has worn off!

triggers.name: Incoming Necro Twitch
triggers.pattern: ^A foreign surge of mana refreshes your mind\.$

triggers.name: Missed Note (Bard)
triggers.pattern: ^You miss a note, bringing your song to a close\!$

triggers.name: Not Standing, Can't Cast
triggers.pattern: ^You must be standing to cast a spell\.$

triggers.name: Root Break
triggers.pattern: ^Your (Engulfing Roots|Engorging Roots|Ensnaring Roots|Enstill|Enveloping Roots|Fetter|Grasping Roots|Immobilize|Paralyzing Earth|Root|Hungry Earth) spell has worn off\.$

triggers.name: Silenced
triggers.pattern: ^You *CANNOT* cast spells, you have been silenced\!$

triggers.name: Snare Off
triggers.pattern: \^Your\ \(Snare\|Ensnare\|Bonds\ of\ Tunare\|Wrath\ of\ Nature\|Clinging\ Darkness\|Engulfing\ Darkness\|Dooming\ Darkness\|Cascading\ Darkness\|Devouring\ Darkness\)\ spell\ has\ worn\ off\\\.\$

triggers.name: Target Too Low Level
triggers.pattern: ^Your spell is too powerful for your intended target\.$

triggers.name: Forage
triggers.pattern: ^You have scrounged up some water.|You have scrounged up some food.|You fail to locate any food nearby.|You have scrounged up something that doesn't look edible.|You fail to locate any food nearby.

triggers.name: Group Invite
triggers.pattern: ^([\w]+) invites you to join a group\.$

triggers.name: Group Invite (Considering)
triggers.pattern: ^([\w]+) is currently considering joining another group\.$

triggers.name: Group Leader (Other)
triggers.pattern: ^([\w]+) is now the leader of your group\.$

triggers.name: Group Leader (You)
triggers.pattern: ^You are now the leader of your group\.$

actions.text: You are now the leader of your group

triggers.name: Left Group
triggers.pattern: ^You have been removed from the group\.$

triggers.name: Raid Invite
triggers.pattern: ^([\w]+) invites you to join a raid\.$

triggers.name: Earthquake!
triggers.pattern: ^(([\w -'`]+) BROADCASTS, 'Minions gather, their forms appearing as time and space coalesce\.'|You feel the (need to get somewhere safe quickly\.|sudden urge to seek a safe location\.))$

triggers.name: Disarmed Ranged
triggers.pattern: ^You are too far away to disarm. Get closer.

triggers.name: General Discipline Cooldown
triggers.pattern: ^You can use the ability {S1} again in {S2}\.$

triggers.name: Line of Sight
triggers.pattern: ^You can't see your target from here\.$

triggers.name: Out of Range
triggers.pattern: ^Your target is too far away, get closer\!$

triggers.name: Kick Cooldown
triggers.pattern: ^(You kick {S} for {N} poin(t|ts) of damage\.|You try to kick .+, but (miss|(.+ (ripostes|dodges|parries)|.+'s magical skin absorbs the blow))\!)$

triggers.name: Slam/Bash/Kick Cooldown
triggers.pattern: ^(You (kick|bash) {S} for {N} poin(t|ts) of damage\.|You try to (kick|bash) .+, but (miss|(.+ (ripostes|dodges|parries)|.+'s magical skin absorbs the blow))\!)$

triggers.name: Race (Roll Over 900)
triggers.pattern: ^\*\*It could have been any number from 0 to 1000, but this time it turned up a (?P<N>(?:9[0-9]{2}|[1-9][0-9]{3,})).$

triggers.name: Invis Dropping
triggers.pattern: You\ feel\ yourself\ starting\ to\ appear
